verdict.purpose: The Suspicious / Not flagged word only.

motion.name: print-in
motion.purpose: Report rows printing in when a result lands.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 600 17px Mukta, sans-serif; padding: 10px 28px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #0e5c63; background: #0e5c63; color: #fff; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #0a464c; }

components.name: H Flag
components.css: .ds-flag { display: inline-block; min-width: 1.6em; padding: 0 4px; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; font: 800 17px/1.4 Mukta, sans-serif; color: #c62828; border: 1.5px solid #c62828; border-radius: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The scan result reads like a diagnostic lab report: value, reference limit, H flag.

rules.name: The Out-of-Range Rule
rules.body: Flag red only on values above their reference limit.

dos: Print the threshold beside every score.
donts: No shields, padlocks, or dark security-console styling.
